title: Low-degree mass and stable influence at one third
statement: Let $f$ be a sign-valued Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, let $i$ be a coordinate, and let $k$ be a natural number. The low-degree coordinate mass of $f$ at $i$ through degree $k$ is at most $3^k$ times the stable influence of the real-valued version of $f$ at $i$ with parameter $1/3$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube
